description: The figure group is a single image: Table 1, a rendered text table of measured chemical compositions, with no micrographs, plots or schematics. The table has seven columns headed Samples, Mn, Al, C, Cr, S and Fe, and three data rows for the steel strips labelled 0Cr steel, 3Cr steel and 6Cr steel; the caption states the unit as wt. %. Reading across, 0Cr steel gives 20.43 Mn, 9.16 Al, 1.17 C, 0 Cr, 0.0006 S and Bal. Fe; 3Cr steel gives 20.04 Mn, 9.09 Al, 1.23 C, 3.09 Cr, 0.0009 S and Bal. Fe; 6Cr steel gives 20.18 Mn, 9.12 Al, 1.20 C, 6.08 Cr, 0.0011 S and Bal. Fe. Mn, Al and C are therefore nearly constant across the three strips (Mn 20.04-20.43, Al 9.09-9.16, C 1.17-1.23), whereas Cr is deliberately stepped from 0 to 3.09 to 6.08 and S drifts slightly over 0.0006-0.0011. "Bal." indicates the remainder is Fe (no numeric Fe value is printed). The table establishes that the three strips form a controlled Cr-addition series on a common Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.2C base, which is the single compositional variable this study manipulates.
measured_quantities: density (g/cm3) (cited in text, not in the table)

observations.observation: The table has seven columns headed Samples, Mn, Al, C, Cr, S and Fe, and exactly three data rows labelled 0Cr steel, 3Cr steel and 6Cr steel.
Row '0Cr steel' lists Mn 20.43, Al 9.16, C 1.17, Cr 0, S 0.0006 and Fe Bal.
Row '3Cr steel' lists Mn 20.04, Al 9.09, C 1.23, Cr 3.09, S 0.0009 and Fe Bal.
Row '6Cr steel' lists Mn 20.18, Al 9.12, C 1.20, Cr 6.08, S 0.0011 and Fe Bal.
Cr is the only element systematically varied across the three strips (0, 3.09, 6.08), while Mn (20.04-20.43), Al (9.09-9.16) and C (1.17-1.23) stay essentially constant.
Fe is reported only as 'Bal.' in every row; no numeric Fe content is printed.
The caption states that Table 1 gives the measured compositions of the studied steel strips in wt. %.
The citing text states that the compositions of the steel strips were measured by Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP) and a CS2800 carbon-sulfur analyzer.
The citing text states that the low-density steel strips with 0, 3 wt % and 6 wt % Cr are referred to as '0Cr', '3Cr' and '6Cr', respectively.

The citing text states measured average densities of 6.71 g/cm3 (0Cr), 6.69 g/cm3 (3Cr) and 6.66 g/cm3 (6Cr), measured with an AccuPyc II 1340 Gas Displacement Density Analyzer; these values are not printed in the table itself.
The citing text identifies the material system as low-density Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.2C-xCr near-rapidly solidified steel strips, consistent with the tabulated base composition.
